about.title: About me
about.body: Full Stack Web Developer with 9+ years building responsive, performant, and accessible (WCAG) web applications. I've led development teams and turned design into interfaces that rank (SEO) and convert. I work with React, Next.js, Vue 3, and Angular on the frontend; NestJS and Laravel on the backend — and I especially enjoy systems with complex business logic: payments, real-time, roles and permissions.
